concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-reports-and-fees-balance-platform-accounting-report]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace daily/interactive Balance Platform Accounting Report field and event guide for liable/user accounts, CET booking window, pending-versus-booked IDs, value dates and split types; sample chargeback amount and payout/top-up IDs conflict.
warnings: A booked bank-transfer row records balance-account movement, not independent beneficiary-bank receipt; individual outcome tracking also uses API/webhook evidence.

Sample chargeback prose says EUR 60 versus EUR 10.97 rows; top-up rows reuse a payout Transfer Id and show Balance (PC) +100 while remaining received with blank Transaction Ids. Do not derive a join or completed top-up from those examples.
